title.zh: DSH 插件索引 · 观察池

description.en: Passed every hard gate but scored low or carries unresolved soft warnings.
description.zh: 通过全部硬门，但分数偏低或带有未解决的软风险。

description.en: Live DeepSeek API token price bar for the web GUI: peak/off-peak tariff, UTC + local (Quebec) clocks, countdown to the next tariff change, and a daily self-verification against the official DeepSeek pricing page.
DSH 网页版桌面宠物「肥鲸」——蓝发鲸鱼娘，固定在 harness 页面右下角：会眨眼、能拖拽、点击可聊天，支持语音对话、念诗说书、饭点提醒。
Use ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok, Antigravity, Kimi, GLM, Cursor, Kiro, Copilot, Qwen, ERNIE, Spark, JetBrains, Perplexity, Replit, and Cody subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers via OAuth.
AI 写作工作台：远程Claude与Codex（主机常驻进程，经 aw-acp 接回），员工电脑文件由主机 agent 经 ssh 操作。
Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
DSH Flash 精简预设：两个 agent 预设（精简·PTC v3（lean-v3），flash-lean-ptc-v3，13 条规则，默认；精简·PTC v3 balance，flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance，3 条规则），以 DSH 组合包（dsh.bundle）形式安装到 profile，并附带计划模式组件（plan-mode v1）。
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 纯净写作协作预设插件（fork 自 chuanban-dsh-writingset）

Plugin-authoring skill for DeepSeek Harness: the distilled anatomy, client-UI recipe, slots, locale, theme tokens, install steps, gotchas, and validation checklist for building and publishing new DSH plugins.
DSH 远程隧道云官方客户端插件：一条命令把本机 DeepSeek Harness 接入云端隧道（设备码绑定、短期令牌、本地门禁代理、HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 反向隧道）。
Create Blender product scenes in DSH with editable recipes, model imports, previews and PNG/MP4 delivery; includes workbench and agent configuration.
在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中以会话级 artifact 安全展示交互式 HTML 可视化。
Cordis plugin: image/video backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.
A practical guide to DSH plugin quality: ENTRY checks, FLOW checks, and BOOST guidance. Community guide; not official, not a certification, not a ranking.
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.

AryaCode engineering bundle: one install surface for the Studio 5000 L5X, FactoryTalk View ME, MotionWorks IEC and FactoryTalk Optix surfaces, one row per product, with the ladder and display previews.
Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
550C 皮肤：把 DeepSeek Harness 的整个界面换成 550C 控制台——四套磷光配色（琥珀/绿/青/白）、扫描线与暗角、等宽字体、机器读数栏，与 dsh-550c-boot 的开机片头同一套视觉。
A2A protocol for DSH: expose a DSH Session as a standard A2A agent, call remote A2A agents, and run invite-only collaboration groups where a group is itself an A2A agent behind a gateway.
DSH 原生分层上下文压缩：模型自己把旧对话折成三层摘要，只写宿主本来就认识的会话事件。名字取自「渐渐消退」——模拟记忆的自然衰退，越旧的内容分辨率越低，但不是删掉。
DeepSeek Harness 插件：接入官方 IAR C-SPY MCP Server，在对话里编译、下载和调试 IAR Embedded Workbench 工程，并提供中文配置页与 iar-cspy 技能。

Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: let the model schedule its own alarms (once / interval / cron with random jitter), wake cold sessions on time, gate model-initiated follow-ups with quiet hours and a daily budget, and reclaim silent wake turns with tombstone compaction; ships a we…
Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作 + 原生视觉模型接入（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 直读截图），screen_observe 等 20 个模型友好工具；浏览器组 browser_* 为兜底
Telegram duty gateway for DeepSeek Harness: long-poll Telegram into a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding while on duty, and a local/duty watch toggle.
Drag local files into the DSH Web UI and insert their original filesystem paths without uploading or copying them

DeepSeek Harness 换肤插件（Dream Skin for DSH）：8 套 iOS / Linear 式清透冷调的高质感主题 + 弥散光壁纸 + 每皮肤智能背景 + 强调色 + 主题包分享，把换肤做成材质与配色克制的高级感工艺，而非贴图。Works in native DSH Web and third-party desktop clients (DSH Desktop): 8 original premium themes, glass materials, wallpaper 2.0, per-user accent, shareable theme packs — p…

DSH global supervisor plugin: cross-workspace project management, task dispatch, status monitoring, scheduled inspections and event response. SQLite-backed state, structured worker reports, no DSH core modification.
ADHD-friendly output shaping for DeepSeek Harness: one system-prompt section with on/off/status tools, persisted across restarts
DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。
DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。
Inspect and advance PlanFlow items across worktrees: dispatch workers through the runtime preflight and follow them in a colour-coded panel.
DSH companion plugin for qq-bridge: chat memory archive/search/summary, web sticker sending and TTS voice messages over OneBot.

Kimi WebBridge host plugin for DeepSeek Harness: model tools that drive the user's REAL browser (navigate, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, screenshot, network inspection, tab management) through the local kimi-webbridge daemon
DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.
鲸编程 - 不只是手机遥控操作电脑,而是将电脑级的Agent能力装进手机

Monitor 数据搬运工作室:左侧导航独立入口,把一个 Monitor 公司的数据(主数据/BOM/未结订单/库存快照/附加字段)经官方 API 搬进另一个 Monitor 系统,跨版本不动表结构/角色/权限。自带进程内引擎(源库直读+目标API写入)与操作手册。A sidebar-entry data transfer studio for DeepSeek Harness: moves one Monitor company into another via official APIs only.

Presmium's bundle for DeepSeek Harness: the workbench of presmium studio, its host side (Presmium's tools, approvals, document context, skills and routes) and its client side (the root layout and the workbench's panels, precompiled) (experimental)

Character presets with WebP icons and colored badge chips for DeepSeek Harness Web profiles, plus financial, market research, strategy planning, cross-border ecommerce, and software engineering roles (Tauri/Rust, MCP, Vue, security, delivery, observability)
Oh My Pi bash runtime ported as a deepseek-harness tool plugin: persistent shell session, output minimizer, managed background jobs, command interception
Transactional task graphs with a conversation panel for DeepSeek Harness
Task-scoped direct model execution, native tools and durable context checkpoints for DeepSeek Harness
Supervised swarm for DeepSeek Harness: a watch officer agent, deterministic hard guards, and cross-source evidence.

Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects three per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls, self-repeating low-entropy reasoning) and re-fires instead of latching; plus three mid-stream breakers that end …
DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct

Argo 阿尔戈 — DSH plugin：argo 原生搜索/抓取工具 + web_search seam + wide_research 编排；自带设置页（接入/工具/API 密钥/研究/高级）；argo MCP 19 工具全量面按需挂载。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add @taxueseek/argo-dsh（或从 GitHub main 装：dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo#main&path:packages/dsh-plugin"）

DSH web 插件：通过 DSH v0.1.5-rc.1 原生第三方语言 API（locale.addLanguage + register(ns, locale, dict)）注册 19 种内置语言字典（ja/ko/fr/...），语言直接出现在 DSH 设置页原生 Language 行中切换，未覆盖文案按 fallback 链回退英文。 | DSH web plugin: registers 19 bundled third-language dictionaries (ja/ko/fr/...) through DSH v0.1.5-rc.1's native language-pa…
Browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: Playwright-powered open/click/type/screenshot/eval tools so the agent can drive real web pages.
